Utility functions:

```{r}
load_data <- function(dir_name, metric) {
  file_path <- paste0(base_path, dir_name, "/", metric, ".csv")
  return(read.csv(file_path))
}

process_data <- function(data, iteration_steps) {
  if (!is.numeric(iteration_steps) || iteration_steps <= 0) {
    stop("iteration_steps must be a positive integer")
  }

  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(evaluation = row_number()) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      mean = mean(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = mean + 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation))))),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation)))))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(evaluation, mean, upper, lower)
  
  return(processed_data)
}
```

```{r}
iteration_steps <- 3000
sla_vio_all <- list()
reconf_all <- list()
reward_all <- list()
se_all <- list()

for (i in seq_along(directories)) {
  dir <- directories[i]
  name <- names[i]

  sla_vio_data <- load_data(dir, "sla_vio_times")
  reconf_data <- load_data(dir, "reconf_times")
  reward_data <- load_data(dir, "reward")
  res <- try({
    se_data <- load_data(dir, "se")
  })

  sla_vio_stats <- process_data(sla_vio_data, iteration_steps)
  reconf_stats <- process_data(reconf_data, iteration_steps)
  reward_stats <- process_data(reward_data, iteration_steps)
  if (!inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    se_stats <- process_data(se_data, iteration_steps)
  }

  sla_vio_stats$source <- name
  reconf_stats$source <- name
  reward_stats$source <- name
  if (!inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    se_stats$source <- name
  }

  sla_vio_all[[i]] <- sla_vio_stats
  reconf_all[[i]] <- reconf_stats
  reward_all[[i]] <- reward_stats
  if (!inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    se_all[[i]] <- se_stats
  }
}

# 将列表转为数据框
sla_vio_all <- do.call(rbind, sla_vio_all)
reconf_all <- do.call(rbind, reconf_all)
reward_all <- do.call(rbind, reward_all)
if (length(se_all) > 0) {
  se_all <- do.call(rbind, se_all)
}
```

```{r}
rewp = ggplot(data = reward_all, aes(x = evaluation, y = mean, color = source)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = source), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Episode Reward between Algorithms",
       x = "Iterations",
       y = "Mean Episode Reward") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
